stories.title: Sacramento Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Active weather continues Thursday with possible thunderstorms and slight risk of tornadoes. Snow level lowers to near 3,500 feet.

stories.title: Sacramento residents brace for more rain as localized flooding concerns grow
stories.summary: But homeowners weren't the only ones keeping an eye on rising water.

stories.title: Two teens hospitalized after stabbing near Madison Avenue and Jackson Street
stories.summary: Sacramento County sheriff's deputies are investigating after two teenagers told deputies they were stabbed by a man near Madison Avenue.

stories.title: Sutter County city could lose around-the-clock firefighter staffing under proposed changes
stories.summary: The uncertainty over fire protection comes as the city prepares for another public safety reduction.

stories.title: California Winter Storm: Widespread road closures and power outages
stories.summary: Northern California braces for hazardous travel as a major winter storm brings heavy rain and mountain snow, possible road closures, and outages.

stories.title: Heavy Sierra snowfall creates dangerous driving conditions along I-80
stories.summary: Heavy snow and multiple spinouts disrupted travel along Interstate 80 in the Sierra on Wednesday.

stories.title: California faces another budget deficit, nonpartisan state analysts warn, pointing to stock market risks
stories.summary: California is preparing its next state budget with volatile revenue gains. It's Governor-elect Xavier Becerra's first state budget.

stories.title: Mother, daughter arrested after severed head found in Foresthill identified 4 years later
stories.summary: A mother and daughter were arrested in connection with a 2022 murder after a man's severed head was found in a trash bag in Placer County.

stories.title: Heavy rain floods Stockton streets as crews race to clear storm drains
stories.summary: City officials opened three sandbag locations Wednesday.

stories.title: Suspect arrested in repeated vandalism of Sikh sign in Granite Bay
stories.summary: A suspect has been arrested after a Sikh religious sign in Granite Bay was vandalized multiple times since June, according to the Placer County Sheriff's Office.

stories.title: Two arrested in fatal Grass Valley hit-and-run involving e-bike rider
stories.summary: A man and woman were arrested in connection with a hit-and-run crash that killed an e-bike rider in Grass Valley on Nov. 11.

stories.title: Man found dead after garage fire at Pine Grove home
stories.summary: Officials have not released information about the cause of the fire or the circumstances surrounding the man's death.
